name: Shoogle
summary: Search engine for shadcn UI components, blocks and templates across community registries, with an MCP server for agents.
description: Searchable index of shadcn registry items - components, blocks and templates from community registries - plus a directory of 434 registries. Items install with the shadcn CLI through the @shoogle registry namespace, and an MCP server with a skill lets AI agents search and install components from Cursor, Claude Code and other clients.
